verdict.rationale: Sentry's docs describe an Issues page for seeing and debugging application errors, list stack traces and suspect commits, and document release management and deploy notifications through the CLI. Nothing in the pack documents regression detection, such as flagging an issue that reappears after being resolved, and grouping logic and the release-health UI are only implied. Missing for 10: documented regression detection, explicit documentation of how errors are grouped into issues, release tracking shown in the issue view beyond CLI release management, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see application errors grouped into issues with stack traces, release tracking, and regression detection

citations.quote: Learn how to use Sentry's Issues page, where you can see and start to debug errors and performance problems that are affecting your application.
Suspect commits, stack traces, and PR comments.
Deploy notifications and source map uploads.
